reviewSamples.author: Photo of Elizabeth Vera
reviewSamples.text: absolutely gorgeous property, very well maintained and beautiful. i’ve been here twice now and both time have been amazing. raksai is super nice and really helpful when it comes to posing and helping out in general. she provides lots of the accessories needed and has a helper that is very quick at work. honestly awesome experience and i loved every second of it.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jerson Arias
reviewSamples.text: The photos are spectacular, the photographers are highly flexible and work well with dynamic situations. The waiting room experience is abysmal. The owner was adamant that my disabled son stay out in the 90° heat.  Will never come back.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Elda Maria Garcia-Griffitts
reviewSamples.text: This place is a true gem of the Tampa Bay Area, and a paradise beyond words.  The owner and staff are amazing as they go above and beyond to ensure your vision becomes a reality. They jumped right in to assist and ensure our photographer achieved the perfect shot.  We are blessed to have chosen Blue Lagoon for our photoshoot destination.  Thank you! Gracias por todo señora Linda, usted y su equipo son maravillosos 💕

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Lizmarie Garcia
reviewSamples.text: This place is gorgeous!! The scenery, the props, the decorations, everything is so well done and it makes every photo look magical. There are so many options and things that you can do with this setting. The owner is also such a kind, welcoming and flexible person and she is passionate about maintaining the space and giving everyone the best experience. If you're looking for a perfect place to take pictures for any occasion, I would 100% recommend this place.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Leidys
reviewSamples.text: If you are in the Central Florida and surrounding areas, look no further!!! The best of the best for your quinceañera!!! My daughter had a lovely and perfect quinceañera session. Thank you to our photographer Betty and major thank yous’ to Racsai and team. Best of the best.
